loss: Per-window valid-value reconstruction MSE; window mean; no upper hierarchy or auxiliary objective

readout.projection: update-only full-SVD PCA, centered, no whitening, width320

bootstrap.cluster: source calendar date of window endpoint
bootstrap.pairing: same resampled days across methods and seeds; average seed differences, not independent sample pooling

limitations: All evaluation periods have informed development
States/transitions are input-derived proxies, not human activities
Reconstruction errors are not validated anomaly scores
Few calendar days limit uncertainty estimates
Additional graph parameters are not a parameter-matched topology intervention
Exact raw rules are a reference ceiling, not a learning baseline to outperform
